title: Bio-Inspired Auditory Processing: Coupling Parallel Resonate-and-Fire Dynamics with Ternary Recurrent Networks for Speech Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.29720v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) promise energy-efficient inference through sparse, event-driven computation, yet remain constrained on continuous, context-dependent tasks such as automatic speech recognition (ASR). A key bottleneck is the Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neuron, whose membrane decay erases information across pauses and phonetic boundaries while it must both extract features and retain long-range context. Inspired by cortical separation of nonlinear filtering and somatic integration, we introduce the Spiking Ternary GRU (stGRU): a ternary-weight gated recurrent unit performs temporal filtering, while downstream Resonate-and-Fire (RF) neurons generate the binary spike stream driving the next block's event pathway. This makes binary event transmission a native training constraint rather than a separate deployment-time activation quantization step; together with ternary weights, learned projections avoid dense floating-point

translated_title: 仿生听觉处理：耦合并行共振-发放动力学与三值循环网络用于语音识别
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）通过稀疏的事件驱动计算有望实现高能效推理，但在自动语音识别（ASR）这类连续、依赖上下文的任务中仍受到限制。一个关键瓶颈是泄漏积分发放（LIF）神经元：其膜电位衰减会在停顿和语音边界处抹除信息，而它同时既要提取特征又要保留长程上下文。受大脑皮层将非线性滤波与胞体整合相分离的机制启发，我们提出了脉冲三值GRU（stGRU）：由三值权重的门控循环单元执行时间滤波，而下游的共振-发放（RF）神经元生成二值脉冲流，驱动下一个模块的事件通路。这使得二值事件传输成为原生的训练约束，而非部署阶段单独的激活量化步骤；结合三值权重，学习到的投影避免了密集的浮点……
tldr: 提出脉冲三值GRU（stGRU），用三值权重门控循环单元进行时间滤波、由共振-发放神经元生成二值脉冲流驱动事件通路，将二值事件传输内化为训练原生约束，从而提升SNN在语音识别等连续上下文任务中的性能与能效。
en_tdlr: We propose the Spiking Ternary GRU (stGRU), which performs temporal filtering via ternary-weight gated recurrent units while downstream Resonate-and-Fire neurons generate binary spike streams, making binary event transmission a native training constraint for energy-efficient speech recognition.
